This is a different raw artifact from the earlier Spanish-translation input.

Modified selection: lowercase English-language headwords in the existing accepted
4–7-letter vocabulary, filling only gaps in the separate Simple English selection.
Up to four POS entries and four senses per entry, up to 1,800 characters per sense.
Supplied sense tags and raw usage labels are preserved. No generated meanings or
inflections; source grammatical form references are retained as such. Quotations,
examples, media, translations and other fields are omitted. Display strips markup.
Selected senses are incomplete and can include labelled rare, regional or historical
uses; presence here does not change answer eligibility or certify Mexican usage.

Reproduce: scripts/export-definition-vocabulary.mjs and
scripts/import-english-definitions.py; input/output hashes, sizes, selection policy
and coverage: src/data/definitions/english-source.json. Original Simple English
records remain unchanged and retain their separate attribution and notice.

Modified dictionary data remains CC BY-SA 4.0, separately from application code.
